reasoning: On the season so far the Heat are the stronger team; with home court the Heat start about 1 points better, in a game of about 242 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Heat win 51 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 214 and 263 total points.

analyst.text: Jaylen Brown returned Monday from a two-game hamstring absence, so Philadelphia should be close to full strength for an East Group B NBA Cup game with real stakes. Miami came into the week 2-0 in the group on a six-game winning streak. Two motivated, healthy-ish teams: no strong lean from the news angle.
